laws.monotone: Admitting more validated structure cannot invalidate retained provenance silently.
laws.idempotent_semantics: Cl_RR(Cl_RR(X)) ~= Cl_RR(X) when B, R, sources, rules, and domain contract are unchanged.
laws.history_non_idempotent: Repeated traversal may append History even when semantic closure is unchanged.

requires: all premises admitted in current domain
output type admitted by domain signature
recovery witness present for any suppressed essential structure
Möbius/orientation behavior typed as invariant, equivariant, or explicitly chiral

triggers: source claim not derivable from mounted corpus

perturbation_policy: Perturbations run in isolated reclosure branches; reclosure is diagnostic and never overwrites canon automatically.
